summary: The generated world put Witness B where she said she was ("on the corner near the crossing"), not where she marked on Exhibit 4. In the deposition video she marks a spot about 11.1 m away, behind the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner). Moving her there blocks her view of the signal, so the world is patched and her claim must be re-tested.

findings.summary: Witness B is placed from her vague spoken description, not from the position she physically marked on Exhibit 4.
findings.detail: At Depo 00:44 she says only "I was waiting for the early bus, over on the corner near the crossing. I had a good view of everything from where I was standing.". At Depo 01:16-01:36 the video shows her marking a red X on Exhibit 4 at approx (x 7, z 16.5) m in the world frame, 11.1 m from where world_v1 places her [5.5, 0, 5.5]. The mark is the controlling evidence of position; the transcript never states it.

findings.summary: From her marked position, the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) stands between Witness B and Signal for northbound Main St (NE corner) at the moment she describes.
findings.detail: The Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) is documented at Police report p.3; Exhibit 1. A sight line from her marked spot (eye 1.6 m) to the signal head at t=6.5s passes through it (independent check: blocked by occ_shelter at 22.8 m). In world_v1 the check reads "clear" only because she was misplaced.

findings.summary: Signal phasing and Vehicle A's skid physics in the world match the record.
